SIDE_TABLE_DECODED_2026-08-03.what_it_is: 0x80089938 is the 'side HP table' that committed Canon (SYS_enemy_death_and_permanence's Do-not-promote list) explicitly warned about -- 'Do not use the side HP-table decrement as the kill definition. The side table floors...' -- but had never located or structured. Structure: 64 records of stride 5, INDEXED BY ACTOR ID, one byte per native berry class: table[actor_id*5 + equipped_berry_index], where the class index is read live from the already-Canon equipped-berry byte 0x800A6597 at every access site.

instruction_level_owners.ko_decrement: 0x8004B258..0x8004B2A8 (inside FUNC_8004ABF4, the proximity updater): on a KO path that sets actor flags |0x880, clears chase bit 0x2, and resets vm_ip to the death program pointer *(0x80077B2C), it reads table[id*5+berry] and -- ONLY while the value exceeds 0x40 -- stores value-2. The -2-per-KO decrement with a floor at 0x40/64, matching the Canon warning's 'floors' verbatim. Multiple sibling blocks in the same function (0x8004B2E8/0x8004B4C0/0x8004B4FC/0x8004B5D4) repeat the pattern for other KO variants.
instruction_level_owners.respawn_clamp_and_aggro_gate: FUNC_80049C30 (the actor/mover initializer, already E07-Canon for program selection): at 0x80049D28 clamps table[id*5+berry] UP to 0x40 if below (sb 0x40); at 0x80049E54 reads the same byte and -- per the listing's branch sense: when the value is >= 100 AND id != 0xF (15, grasshopper, explicitly exempted) -- clears the actor's chase bit 0x2 at (re)spawn. The behavioral DIRECTION (whether beaten-down species respawn more or less aggressive) is deliberately NOT claimed from branch-reading alone -- flagged for one live confirmation.
instruction_level_owners.frontend_scan: 0x80054644.. (inside fcn.80053814's frontend/results dispatch region): scans for ==0xFF entries with a stride-5 loop -- a located-but-undecoded third consumer, plausibly initializing a berry-class column when a class first becomes available.
